Azzurro Sky

4 Bedrooms 8 Full Bathrooms 14 Sleeps Seagrove Beach
  • Description
  • Amenities
  • Reviews
  • Calendar
  • Location

HOME HIGHLIGHTS:

• 4 Bedrooms & 8 Full Baths
• Sleeps 14
• Gulf Front with Private Beach
• Private Rooftop Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $50 per day from October 1 - May 1)
• 4 Stories & 4,216 Square Feet
• 6 Seater Golf Cart & 6 Adult Bikes Included
• Beach Chair Setup (4 Chairs and 2 Umbrella) Provided March 1st - October 31st
• Elevator
• Parking for 3 Vehicles


SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 14)

FIRST FLOOR: (Sleeps 2)
• Living Area with Queen Sleeper Sofa & Shared Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower

THIRD FLOOR: (Sleeps 8)
• Bedroom 1: Guest Suite with King Bed (sleeps 2) - Ensuite Bathroom with Double Vanities & Tile/Glass Shower (Gulf Front with Shared Balcony)
• Bedroom 2: Three Twin over Twin Bunk Beds (sleeps 6) - Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower

FOURTH FLOOR (Sleeps 4)
• Bedroom 3: Primary Suite with King Bed (sleeps 2) - Ensuite Bathroom with Double Vanities, Modern Soaking Tub Tile/Glass Shower
• Bedroom 4: Guest Suite with King Bed (sleeps 2) - Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower

DESCRIPTION:
‘Azzurro Sky’ is a luxurious, Gulf-front masterpiece—a four-bedroom, eight-bathroom villa in the heart of Seagrove Beach, offering an unmatched escape for up to 14 guests. Set against breathtaking Gulf views, this home boasts a private rooftop pool, elevator access, a 6-passenger golf cart, and is just steps from the area's finest shops and restaurants.

The first floor living area invites guests to unwind in style, with a chic wet bar, mini fridge, and a plush queen sleeper sofa, all surrounded by panoramic dune vistas. A convenient bathroom with a walk-in shower is perfect for rinsing off sandy feet after a day on the beach.

On the second floor, an exquisite chef's kitchen awaits, featuring top-of-the-line appliances, a 6-burner Wolf gas range with a griddle, a wine chiller, and both Cuisinart and Keurig coffee makers. Gather around a grand dining table that seats 10, with additional seating for 5 at the kitchen bar. In the adjacent living area, recline on plush sofas and chairs, while soaking in the mesmerizing Gulf views framed by sliding glass doors, which open to a private balcony equipped with an outdoor dining table and gas grilling station.

The third floor hosts a stunning guest bedroom and an inviting bunk room. Young guests will love the three custom-built twin-over-twin bunks, each with a private bathroom and shower. The bunk room opens to a Gulf-front balcony where Adirondack chairs offer the perfect spot for morning sunrises or dolphin watching. The guest bedroom, with its king bed, enjoys sweeping Gulf views and opens to another beachfront balcony. This floor also includes dual sets of stacked washers and dryers, as well as a full bathroom with a walk-in shower.

On the fourth floor, indulge in two luxurious bedrooms with king beds and unparalleled beach views. A guest room offers a private bathroom with a walk-in shower, while the grand primary suite boasts a spa-like experience with a separate soaking tub. An additional guest bathroom with a shower serves those who wish to refresh after a dip in the rooftop pool.

The rooftop oasis is a crowning jewel, showcasing a sun-drenched pool overlooking the shimmering Gulf waters. It’s the perfect spot to toast the sunset and stargaze under the open Florida sky.

‘Azzurro Sky’ offers direct beach access via a private dune walkover shared only with its sister property ‘Azzurro Moon’. These exquisite villas can be rented together. Delight in the elegance of this Seagrove Beach retreat and enjoy an array of premium amenities, from a 6-passenger golf cart and six adult bikes perfect for exploring coveted 30A.

• Spacious Island with seating for 5

• Balcony with outdoor dining for 6 & Grilling Station
• Full Guest Bath

• Full Bathroom

• Bunk Room with 3 Twin Over Twin Bunks & Ensuite Bathroom
• Shared Balcony

• Full Guest Bath
• Balcony Access
